dataNote: Cursor figures are from published Cursor research. Token composition and context scores are teaching illustrations, not Tourist measurements. Tourist status matches the repository as last pushed on 29 September 2026: stages 0–5 checked, cloud API wired to Daytona without a recorded live run, stages 6–8 unchecked.

cursorOnlineAb.Caveat: Many queries do not need search

whatTouristIs.Goal: The repository is an island. Each file is a building. Tests, tools, review, and pull requests are landmarks.
whatTouristIs.In the repo now: A public GitHub URL renders that default branch. 68 file-type buildings. Builders wait at town hall.

whatTouristIs.Goal: A supervisor picks one coder, a specialist chain, or a swarm. They edit, test, and review in a sandbox.
whatTouristIs.In the repo now: solo_coder, coder–tester–reviewer, and an opt-in swarm. CLI, plus a Daytona API that returns a patch.

whatTouristIs.Goal: Every finished run stores reward_v1: tests, diff, tokens, latency, and later the pull request, CI, merge, and revert.
whatTouristIs.In the repo now: heuristic_v1 writes completed, tests, diff, tokens, and latency. Pull-request scores are not filled in.

whatTouristIs.Goal: User, codebase, and episodic notes, plus code rules, retrieved as a small pack. Global memory stays inactive until it is promoted.
whatTouristIs.In the repo now: JSON file, keyword overlap, at most 8 notes. The agent memory tools answer that stage 6 is not available.

whatTouristIs.Goal: Learn discrete choices — model, topology, context, tools, memory, stop, tests — from those scores. Do not train the model that writes the code.
whatTouristIs.In the repo now: The decision table and shadow → canary → active rule are specified. No policy is promoted.

whatTouristIs.Goal: A GitHub App pushes the task branch and opens a pull request. The harbor shows that pull request.
whatTouristIs.In the repo now: create_pull_request records the call. Nothing pushes.

stages.Exit: A public GitHub URL opens a city of that default branch
stages.Status: Checked. Landing page, /owner/repo, and the local report route

stages.Exit: A test script edits a fixture, runs tests, commits, and records a fake PR
stages.Status: Checked. Registry, allowlisted shell, recording GitHub adapter

stages.Exit: One agent produces a tested local commit and a tool trace
stages.Status: Checked. Live OpenAI fixture runs recorded; other providers contract-tested

stages.Exit: Coder, tester, and reviewer run in order, with one review return
stages.Status: Checked on fixtures. Research exists as a role and is not in the default chain

stages.Exit: Two independent edits finish as one tested branch
stages.Status: Checked on local worktrees. Opt-in, 2–4 disjoint file sets

stages.Exit: The same entry point can run solo or swarm, and can register one run-scoped tool
stages.Status: Checked on fixtures. build_tool is count_lines only

stages.Exit: A second task reuses a stored note, and the log shows that id
stages.Status: Unchecked. JSON keyword store is a precursor, not this exit

stages.Exit: A promoted policy beats the heuristic on an eval, at equal or lower cost
stages.Status: Unchecked. reward_v1 is logged. Promotion is not built

stages.Exit: A connected repo and an issue come back as a real pull request
stages.Status: Unchecked. create_pull_request records the call. Nothing pushes

topologies.When it runs: No swarm parts, and the task is short and does not match the bug keywords
topologies.Who works: One coder. The runtime then tests, commits, and records a pull request

topologies.When it runs: Task longer than 120 characters, or it mentions bug, fix, race, regression, auth, security, or refactor
topologies.Who works: Coder, tester, reviewer. One CHANGES_REQUIRED loop. Review must start with ACCEPT
One worktree per coder, then one integration branch and tests

runConstraints.What the code does: ripgrep, fixed string, 20 matches per file, 50,000 characters returned
UTF-8 files inside the checkout. read_file refuses a file above 200,000 characters
node --test, or pnpm/npm test, typecheck, or build. Test tool limit is 120 seconds
list_issues, get_issue, and create_pull_request append the call. They do not use the network
count_lines only, 1–5 fixtures must pass, forgotten when the process ends
Keyword overlap, at most 8 notes, 1,000 characters each in the prompt
Public repo, shallow clone, Daytona sandbox, patch returned, sandbox deleted. Queue is serial, 10 waiting
Default branch, at most 400 files. Line count is 24 plus a hash of the path, modulo 420

stack.Why: Public repo to CitySnapshot, 68 file-type buildings, inspection, ambient traffic
Provider-neutral tool loop. The older plan's Python and OpenAI Agents SDK are not this package

stack.Choice: OpenAI, Anthropic, and Gemini, task-scoped keys
stack.Why: Explicit catalog, default gpt-6-sol. Live fixture evidence recorded for OpenAI
Same runtime locally or against the cloud API. Ribbon, model picker, modes
Public clone, disposable sandbox, patch returned, sandbox deleted. A live Daytona run was not recorded on the board
User, codebase, and episodic notes. Postgres and an embedding index are stage 6
Logged on finished runs. Shadow, canary, and active promotion are stage 7
Today the tools record the call. Push and a real pull request are the last stage
plan.md still names Qdrant. The checkpoint board picks the engine when the record store exists
Not the current renderer. The working viewer is isometric SVG and DOM

memoryScopes.Holds: Preferences such as TypeScript, smaller PRs, pnpm
memoryScopes.Write rule: User- or workspace-scoped; never promoted globally

memoryScopes.Holds: Architecture, conventions, fragile areas, past agent work on this repo
This task failed because X, then Y worked
memoryScopes.Write rule: Task-scoped; retrievable, not always in the prompt

memoryScopes.Holds: For this class of problem, use that tool
Scratch space for later multi-agent runs
memoryScopes.Write rule: Exists in the schema; unused until Gate C
Default deny. Agents never write scope=global, status=active

gates.What must be true: City from a public URL; tools; solo, team, and opt-in swarm on a local checkout; one run-scoped count_lines tool
gates.Still required before calling it shipped: A live Daytona run was not on the board. Local execution is not an OS sandbox

gates.What must be true: Postgres records, embeddings, code rules loaded before the first edit, a second task that reuses a note
gates.Still required before calling it shipped: Agents cannot activate global memory. The JSON keyword store does not satisfy the exit

gates.What must be true: Eval set, shadow then canary then active, promotion only when success holds at equal or lower cost
gates.Still required before calling it shipped: Logging heuristic_v1 is not learning. No model-weight training

gates.What must be true: GitHub App, push of the task branch, a real pull request, CI written onto the same reward
gates.Still required before calling it shipped: The recording adapter stays for tests. Private cities use the installation token

fears.Control: checkpoints.md is the order. Stage 6 before 7 before 8. plan.md loses when they disagree
heuristic_v1 is a log. Promotion needs an eval. No PPO against the model that writes the code

fears.Fear: Global memory as a secret-shaped junk drawer
fears.Control: The JSON store has no global scope. Stage 6 keeps global rows inactive

fears.Fear: A swarm that has never opened a pull request
fears.Control: Swarm is opt-in on fixtures. It does not count as shipping until stage 8’s real PR exit
Ambient traffic stays atmosphere. Builders move only for live edit ids, which the public page does not send

fears.Fear: A tool factory that emits shell scripts
fears.Control: build_tool is count_lines, fixtures must pass, and the tool dies with the run
